unit.why: A single tale told by R. Barukh of Medzhybizh about a dead old scholar who protests in the heavenly court that a young man ranks above him; it ends with God's answer, an exegesis of the verse 'ויהי מקץ שנתיים'.
unit.boundary_note: Division ends with the catchword heading 'מענין אגרת מבני משה' belonging to the next division; the heading 'מענין אברך' for this story sits at the end of the previous division.

stories.start_quote: הנה הה״צ ר״ר ברוך ז״ל ממעזבוז סיפר
stories.end_quote: סרה תלונה הזקן ושלום על ישראל
stories.summary_en: R. Barukh of Medzhybizh tells of an old scholar who reaches heaven and protests that a young man who died early ranks higher. God answers from the verse 'מקץ שנתים ימים': a man's years count only by the days truly devoted to service, and the young man, who never left Torah and prayer, had more such days than the old man, who also traded.
